Author: holorigg
Name: Wayfinder
Punchline: GPS-style path on the ground to your map flag or quest objective.
Description: Draws the walking route on the ground to the map flag or to the current step of a quest, across zone exits, with city aethernet and teleport suggestions. Only draws; never moves the character. Requires vnavmesh (https://puni.sh/api/repository/veyn). Open with /way.
